title: the verdict gate disposes a host-bound tooth from the seal of the host that ran it
intention: The verdict gate's disposition of a hypothesis whose instrument fails only on teeth this host cannot run (UNRAN) reads the green seal a host that could run them took on these bytes, through verdict's host_bound_reading, so a Windows-only proof can reach PROVED from the Linux verdict; any other failure, or no such seal, stays killed.
why: Measured 2026-11-23 on akiendelllinux: dc945eb1f072's Linux verdict was disposed killed ('bin/cairn test bin/proofs/test_cairn_resolves_from_powershell.py exited 1') while akiendell_cc_0's Windows seal of that proof on these bytes stood green on both teeth with its hollow evidence (main 670ba5fed). The Linux run's only FAIL lines read UNRAN. StageGate._dispose in cairn/devices/codemother/machines/chart_gate/gate.py runs each hypothesis instrument and disposes confirmed only on exit 0; 50ac45cde4dd's host_bound_reading is asked only by the verdict door's criterion re-run (verdict.py, every_reported_outcome_survives_its_re_run). The verdict cannot run on Windows today (no bubblewrap), so the ticket has no host it can be proved from.
traces_to: Law 3 (nothing is known until measured: the seal from the host that can run the tooth is the measurement, and the gate discards it) and Law 8 (a proof gates entry to proven-space; a gate that cannot read a valid proof makes a host-bound component unprovable).
how: In StageGate._dispose, when a run did not time out and did not exit 0, ask V.host_bound_reading(command, run.get('fail_lines'), V.CAIRN_ROOT); a non-None reading disposes the hypothesis confirmed with host_read beside it and the seal date in 'by'; None leaves it killed. Update the module docstring's disposition sentence in the same act. Red-first proof beside the gate: injected runner, a scratch component holding a fixture seal, one tooth per clause.

clauses.claim: a hypothesis whose run exits 1 with every fail line carrying UNRAN, and whose proof holds a green seal on these bytes naming those teeth green and none red, is disposed confirmed and the disposition carries host_read naming the teeth
the same run with any fail line that does not carry UNRAN is disposed killed
the same run with no seal on these bytes (no seal at all, or a seal taken on other bytes) is disposed killed
a run exiting 0 is disposed confirmed with no host_read, and a timed-out run is disposed killed
the gate asks verdict's own host_bound_reading: with verdict.host_bound_reading replaced by one returning None for the call, clause 1's run is disposed killed

decisions.text: D1: StageGate._dispose asks V.host_bound_reading for a failed, not-timed-out run, and disposes confirmed with host_read when it returns a reading; the 'by' text keeps the command and exit and appends the seal date; the module docstring's 'confirmed when it exited 0 inside its bound, killed otherwise' sentence names the host-bound reading.

D2: the proof builds a scratch component holding a fixture seal (the approach of the verdict machine's host-bound proof) and a scratch commons with validate and hypothesize berths (the approach of the far-box berth proof), injects a runner returning the measured run shapes, and calls StageGate('verdict')._dispose, one tooth per clause.

constraints: host_bound_reading is called through verdict's published face (cairn.devices.codemother.machines.verdict.verdict, as V), never copied into gate.py (RULE 1, Law 1)
a failed run with ANY fail line not carrying UNRAN, or with no green seal on these bytes, stays killed: the gate never confirms on a reading host_bound_reading did not return

out: running the verdict on a box without bubblewrap (86cccb7d30f7)

measured.saw: dc945eb1f072 verdict disposed killed: 'bin/cairn test bin/proofs/test_cairn_resolves_from_powershell.py exited 1', with akiendell_cc_0's green Windows seal and hollow evidence on these bytes at main 670ba5fed

the Linux run of that proof prints exactly two FAIL lines, tooth_1 and tooth_2, each 'AssertionError: UNRAN: ... Windows-only', and exits 1; the recovery floor proof (8610b4aa2477) exits 0 on Linux, so it is not affected
measured.how: bin/cairn test <proof> on akiendelllinux at main ad6b15ac2

measured.saw: StageGate._dispose sets 'confirmed' if exit == 0 else 'killed' and never calls host_bound_reading; host_bound_reading is called only at verdict.py's every_reported_outcome_survives_its_re_run
measured.how: read of cairn/devices/codemother/machines/chart_gate/gate.py lines 162-190 and grep for host_bound_reading
